name: Switchroom service-socket residual-current interface
summary: Identifies residual-current protection assigned to the documented room service-socket circuit.
description: Identifies residual-current protection assigned to the documented room service-socket circuit. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Service-socket circuit condition” at the input and “Socket circuit protective action” at the output. Required protection depends on installation rules.
